comparison.objective: Tune and lock a shock absorber, versus clear a fragile egg from a trivet before placing a pot.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision tool insertion, bounded screw torque, collar rotation, and iterative testing; record uses delicate relocation and stable heavy-object placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires two compliant dynamic cycles under numeric travel and force limits. Record requires supported final placements with pot/egg contact at or below 0.20 N and no fall or invalid object state.
comparison.reason: Fragile-obstruction handling tests safe sequencing and delicate placement, while the candidate tests mechanism adjustment and measured damping response. Shared safety sequencing is only a generic primitive.
